name: Darkwood Tree, Small House
desc1: This comfortable one-room dwelling is built right into the heart of
desc2: the living Darkwood tree. The furniture in the room seems to have
desc3: blended right in with the tree's natural growth, as roots twist along-
desc4: side without providing obstruction. A small fire burns in a vented
desc5: stone fireplace opposite the door, and a bed and table occupy the rest
